title: Reuse a mixin
summary: A mixin is a group of style choices you can insert into another rule.
introduction: A mixin is a group of style choices you can insert into another rule. Your task: Use soft-box in a third rule called message.
learningObjectives: Use soft-box in a third rule called message.
Explain the example for reuse a mixin

blocks.text: A mixin is a group of style choices you can insert into another rule. Empty parentheses keep the recipe from making its own CSS class.
Use Less 4 on your computer. Install Node.js first. Save examples as lesson.less, then run npx lessc lesson.less lesson.css. The browser loads lesson.css; this site does not build Less.
Read the code step by step

items: The parentheses make `soft-box` a Less mixin recipe. Calling it inside a rule copies its declarations there.

blocks.text: Both card and tip get the two style choices. No separate soft-box rule is needed.

blocks.title: A mistake to avoid
blocks.text: Call the mixin inside a selector rule. Defining the recipe alone does not style a page part.

blocks.title: Your small task
blocks.text: Use soft-box in a third rule called message.
